claims.text: Large language models are widely used in decision-making tasks.
Large language model reliability in critical tasks like healthcare is not well-established.
Large language models learn to infer latent concepts during pretraining.
Response uncertainty in large language models decreases as the prompt's informativeness increases.

evidence.description: Detailed experimental results on real-world datasets validate the proposed prompt-response concept model.

methodologies.name: Prompt-response concept model
methodologies.description: A model explaining how LLMs generate responses via latent concepts to analyze the relation between prompts and response uncertainty.

limitations.text: The reliability of LLMs in critical tasks like healthcare is not well-established.
